clues.text: Standing 200 feet tall, this non-inverting coaster sends riders flying along the track at speeds up to 70 mph.
Manufactured by the Swiss ride masters at B&M, this coaster first debuted to riders in 2006.
You can find this soaring thrill machine at an amusement park located in the state of Georgia.
This towering steel roller coaster is one of the signature headlining attractions at Six Flags Over Georgia.
Its name refers to the legendary biblical giant who was famously defeated by David with a sling and a stone.

evidence.quote: Goliath is a steel roller coaster located at Six Flags Over Georgia in Mableton, Georgia, United States.
